question: Does the frozen primary source contain a graph-level contour-to-energy regulator map whose image lies in one quadratic Kummer chamber?

sources.finding: Defines the Bunch-Davies integral and invokes a suitable i-epsilon prescription, but gives no relation among site-energy regulators and no exceptional-tangent map.

locations: Section 2 around equations (2.6) and the energy-space regularization discussion
sources.finding: Uses E -> E-i epsilon_E for each energy and defines the Cayley-Menger contour/measure, but supplies no graph-level relation restricting independent positive epsilon_E to one chamber.

missing_datum: A source-derived map from the normalized Cayley-Menger contour family to the projectivized energy-regulator tangent satisfying either sqrt(2)*epsilon_2 > epsilon_1+epsilon_3 everywhere or the opposite strict inequality.
conclusion: No chamber-selecting graph-level regulator map exists in the frozen primary source set. Physical activation of the quadratic Kummer line is closed as undefined under current sources.
